name: The Final Days
description: Create two tapped 2/2 black Horror creature tokens. Flashback {4}{B}{B}. If you cast this spell using flashback, create a number of tapped 2/2 black Horror creature tokens equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
assumptions: Named the alt-cost-from-graveyard-then-exile pattern "Flashback" — schema's own vocabulary for altCost.
Used the standard fixed Flashback reminder-text wording.

Invented connective phrasing to join the two independent cast-root branches into one paragraph; the underlying fact (two branches, different token counts) is derived, the exact glue is the examiner's own wording.
Left the sorcery's own default resting-zone move (stack->gy) out of print, since it states nothing beyond the default.
notes: Full mechanical meaning preserved: normal cast makes 2 tokens, flashback cast makes X tokens (X = creature cards in graveyard) instead, flashback cost and post-resolution exile both correct. Real oracle text phrases the conditional as one paragraph ("If this spell was cast from a graveyard, instead create X...") with Flashback as a separate trailing line, rather than the examiner's two-cast-roots-then-Flashback-reminder ordering — a presentation/ordering difference, not a mechanical one, and the examiner itself flagged this as invented connective wording rather than a derived fact.
